newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's SEPI details Repsol privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Spain's SEPI details Repsol privatisation.

text.p: Spanish state holding company SEPI detailed on Friday the privatisation of energy group Repsol, with an initial offer of 22.95 million shares extendable to 25.5 million.
According to documents sent to the stock market commission by SEPI, the total offer is 30,002,859 shares, which includes 4.5 million shares to be sold to Repsol employees.
The 30 million shares in total represent the government's last 10.001 percent stake in the firm.
The retail share offer will include a four percent discount.
The privatisation envisages a period in which provisional share orders can be placed, after which the maximum sale price will be fixed.

In the document, SEPI said "The initial assignation to the different tranches...foresees a wide possibility of redistribution between them in function of the respective demand for each."

Government spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez told reporters this afternoon that the privatisation would end on Friday April 25, with the allocation of shares and the privatisation completed by April 29.
